parsed.rationale: All 15 members are unnamed extensions (name: "") on SwiftUI's `View` type, spread across unrelated packages (WXUI, Wallpaper, PartyHorn, PlayerHeaderView, MusicShareKit, app:iOS) and unrelated domain files such as `GlassEffect+Compatibility.swift`, `PlaybackBlendMode.swift`, `ThemePickerGesture.swift`, `WipeDownRevealModifier.swift`, and `StatusBarStyleModifier.swift`. Extensions on `View` are the idiomatic Swift/SwiftUI mechanism for scoping view-modifier helpers to their declaring type; each extension exists to serve a distinct local concern. The structural signal is purely that they all extend the same standard-library type, not that they share shape, fields, or behaviour. No consolidation is warranted because merging them would couple unrelated packages and destroy locality of reference.
